name: Exp_ColorXdinMA
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXdinMA custom indicator, which is a dual-length smoothing average that changes color based on trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorXdinMA进行交易，该指标是双周期平滑均线，根据趋势方向变色。指标向上时开多仓，向下时开空仓，支持配置止损、止盈和资金管理参数。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorXdinMA指标的趋势方向变化，该指标使用两种不同周期的平滑算法（main和plus周期）生成趋势信号。入场条件为：当指标值在较早两根K线上呈下降趋势（Value[1]<Value[2]）且最新值反转向上（Value[0]>Value[1]）时开多仓；当指标值在较早两根K线上呈上升趋势（Value[1]>Value[2]）且最新值反转向下（Value[0]<Value[1]）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），同时也支持通过信号反转平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理支持多种模式：基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额或固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制每笔交易的风险比例。策略还包含新K线检测机制避免重复信号，以及历史数据加载确保指标计算的完整性。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend direction changes of the ColorXdinMA indicator, which uses two different period smoothing algorithms (main and plus periods) to generate trend signals. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator values show a downtrend on older bars (Value[1]<Value[2]) and the latest value reverses upward (Value[0]>Value[1]); a sell position opens when the indicator values show an uptrend on older bars (Value[1]>Value[2]) and the latest value reverses downward (Value[0]<Value[1]). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), and also support closing via signal reversal (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose). Position sizing supports multiple modes: based on free margin, balance, free margin after losses, balance after losses, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration to manage the risk ratio per trade. The strategy also includes a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate signals, and history data loading to ensure complete indicator calculation.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/固定手数等）

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许信号反转时平多仓

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许信号反转时平空仓

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 指标计算所用的价格类型
parameters.description_en: Price type used for indicator calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取信号的K线索引

pros: 支持10种平滑算法（SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA等），灵活适应不同市场环境
内置新K线检测机制（CIsNewBar），有效防止同一信号重复开仓
开仓和平仓信号独立控制，可分别启用/禁用多空方向的开仓和平仓
多种资金管理模式可选，满足不同风险偏好
默认止损止盈比为1:2，具有正期望的风险回报比
pros_en: Supports 10 smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA etc.), flexibly adapting to different market conditions
Built-in new bar detection mechanism (CIsNewBar) effectively prevents duplicate entries on the same signal
Independent control of open and close signals, allowing separate enable/disable of buy/sell opening and closing
Multiple money management modes available to satisfy different risk preferences
Default stop loss to take profit ratio of 1:2 provides a positive expectancy risk-reward ratio
cons: 默认止损1000点和止盈2000点过大，可能导致单笔亏损金额显著
缺少点差过滤机制，在点差较大时仍会开仓，影响交易成本
没有仓位检查逻辑，可能重复开仓导致同方向持仓叠加
依赖外部自定义指标ColorXdinMA和头文件，部署依赖性较高
SignalBar默认为1但允许为0，当SignalBar=0时逻辑分支不明确
cons_en: Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, potentially leading to significant per-trade losses
No spread filter mechanism, trades can be opened during high spread periods, increasing trading costs
No position check logic, potentially leading to repeated entries and stacked positions in the same direction
Depends on external custom indicator ColorXdinMA and include files, creating higher deployment dependencies
SignalBar defaults to 1 but allows 0, creating ambiguous logic when SignalBar=0
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，当点差超过阈值时禁止开仓以降低交易成本
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过度叠加
优化止损止盈默认值，或引入ATR动态止损以适应不同品种波动率
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to prevent opening positions when spread exceeds a threshold, reducing trading costs
Add position check logic to avoid repeated entries in the same direction that lead to excessive position stacking
Optimize default stop loss/take profit values or introduce ATR-based dynamic stops to adapt to different instrument volatilities

risk_points: 无持仓方向检查，可能同方向重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
默认止损1000点偏大，在高杠杆下单笔亏损可能超过账户承受能力
缺少点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大时仍会交易
risk_points_en: No position direction check, potentially allowing repeated entries in the same direction leading to excessive risk exposure
Default 1000-point stop loss is large, potentially causing single-trade losses exceeding account tolerance under high leverage
No spread filter, trades still execute when spreads widen during high volatility periods

It opens buy positions when the indicator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
